equation.exposition_role: Computes the whole-law mean interval when one region is unavailable but has supplied cash bounds.
equation.symbols_units_domain: Weights3/5 and2/5 are dimensionless masses summing to1;120 and[80,110] use the same cash units and reporting context;[104,116] has those units.
equation.assumptions_timing: The two regions partition the declared law; the unavailable region has valid pointwise or conditional-mean bounds80 and110. No independence assumption is used.
equation.source_and_equality: Local arithmetic: (3/5)120=72 and (2/5)[80,110]=[32,44], whose interval sum is[104,116]. This is a bound under the stated premises.
equation.interpretation: The full-law mean remains bounded despite missing computation;120 alone is the successful-region conditional value.
equation.transition: The unbounded missing-region case removes this conclusion and leads to validation and correction semantics.
